comment: Curated naming/doc overrides for :codegen. Never a source of NBT shape; see codegen/README.md.

boxes[].doc: a box in pixels, 0 to 16 from the block corner

block:minecraft:collision_box.doc: Add-on JSON true / false / [{origin, size}, ...] is sent as {enabled: byte, boxes: [{minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ: float}]}. origin/size become min/max in 0..16 block space (origin + 8); true/false send boxes: []. The single object form {origin, size} is rejected by 1.26.60 JSON (array required). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/collision_box_box.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/collision_box_false.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/collision_box_list.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/collision_box_single_list.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/collision_box_true.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:connection_rule.doc: Add-on JSON {accepts_connections_from?, enabled_directions?} is sent as same keys. defaults "all", ["south","north","east","west"]. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/connection_rule.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/connection_rule_default.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:crafting_table.doc: Add-on JSON {crafting_tags, table_name} is sent as {crafting_tags: [string], table_name: string, grid_size: 3}. grid_size added. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/crafting_table.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

value.doc: seconds to destroy; JSON {@code false} becomes -1

block:minecraft:destructible_by_mining.doc: Add-on JSON false / {seconds_to_destroy, item_specific_speeds} is sent as `{value: float, item_specific_speeds?: [{destroy_speed: float, item: {Name, Aux: 32767s} \. {Tags, MolangVersion: 13s}}]}`. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/destructible_by_mining.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/destructible_by_mining_false.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:destruction_particles.doc: Add-on JSON {texture, tint_method?, particle_count?} is sent as {texture, tint_method: string, particle_count: int}. defaults "none", 100. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/destruction_particles.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/destruction_particles_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:display_name.doc: Add-on JSON "..." is sent as {value: string}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/display_name.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

material_instances.doc: material instance name to material; not the mappings/materials/packed_bools form of minecraft:material_instances

block:minecraft:embedded_visual.doc: Add-on JSON {geometry, material_instances} is sent as {geometry: {bone_visibility, culling, culling_layer, culling_shape, identifier, uv_lock}, material_instances: {<face>: {texture, render_method, tint_method, ambient_occlusion: float, face_dimming, isotropic, alpha_masked_tint: byte}}}. material instances not in the mappings/materials/packed_bools form used by minecraft:material_instances. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/embedded_visual.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:flower_pottable.doc: Add-on JSON {} is sent as {usePreR26U2FlowerPotOffset: 0b}. needs geometry + material_instances. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/flower_pottable.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:friction.doc: Add-on JSON 0.2 is sent as {value: float}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/friction.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

bone_visibility.doc: bone name to a Molang expression; JSON {@code true} becomes {@code "1.000000"}

uv_lock.doc: a byte (boolean) or a list of face names, as in the JSON

block:minecraft:geometry.doc: Add-on JSON "id" / {identifier, bone_visibility, culling, culling_layer, uv_lock} is sent as `{identifier, bone_visibility: {bone: string}, culling: string, culling_layer: string, culling_shape: "", uv_lock: byte \. [string], ignoreGeometryForIsSolid, isV1Fullblock, needsLegacyTopRotation, useBlockTypeLightAbsorption: byte}`. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/geometry_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/geometry_full_block.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/geometry_short.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/geometry_uv_lock_list.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:item_visual.doc: Add-on JSON {geometry, material_instances} is sent as {geometryDescription: <geometry shape>, materialInstancesDescription: <material_instances shape>}. renamed keys, full minecraft:geometry / minecraft:material_instances shapes inside. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/item_visual.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:leashable.doc: Add-on JSON {offset?} is sent as {offset: [float x3]}. default [0, 0.25, 0]. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/leashable.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/leashable_default.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:light_dampening.doc: Add-on JSON 7 is sent as {lightLevel: byte}. renamed. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/light_dampening.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:light_emission.doc: Add-on JSON 10 is sent as {emission: byte}. renamed. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/light_emission.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

detectionRules[].stopsLiquidFromDirectio.doc: direction bit set: down 1, up 2, north 4, south 8, west 16, east 32

block:minecraft:liquid_detection.doc: Add-on JSON {detection_rules: [{liquid_type, can_contain_liquid, on_liquid_touches, stops_liquid_flowing_from_direction}]} is sent as {detectionRules: [{liquidType, canContainLiquid: byte, onLiquidTouches, stopsLiquidFromDirection: byte bit set, use_liquid_clipping: byte}]}. camelCase, direction list -> bit set (down 1, up 2, north 4, ...: ["up","north"] = 6). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/liquid_detection.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

mappings.doc: face alias (e.g. {@code up}) to the material instance it uses

materials.doc: material instance name ({@code *}, a face, or a bone material name) to material

materials{}.packed_bools.doc: bit set: bit 0 face_dimming, bit 1 isotropic, bit 2 always set by BDS (5 = JSON defaults)

block:minecraft:material_instances.notes: Vanilla sends no {@code isotropic} key; flags are packed into {@code packed_bools}.
block:minecraft:material_instances.doc: Add-on JSON {"*": {texture, render_method, ambient_occlusion, face_dimming, isotropic, tint_method}, "up": "north"} is sent as {mappings: {up: {value: "north"}}, materials: {"*": {texture, render_method, tint_method, ambient_occlusion: float, packed_bools: byte}}}. face aliases go to mappings; face_dimming/isotropic packed into packed_bools: bit 0 face_dimming, bit 1 isotropic, bit 2 always set in every capture (5 = default, 6 = no dimming + isotropic); ambient_occlusion float (bool true -> 1.0); needs geometry. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/material_instances.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/material_instances_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:on_player_placing.notes: Rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1 add-on JSON (replaced by script custom components); only Geyser sends it.

conditions[].allowed_faces.doc: face bit set: down 1, up 2, north 4, south 8, west 16, east 32

block:minecraft:placement_filter.doc: Add-on JSON {conditions: [{allowed_faces, block_filter}]} is sent as `{conditions: [{allowed_faces: byte bit set, block_filter: [{name} \. {tags, tags_version: 13}]}]}`. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/placement_filter.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:precipitation_interactio.doc: Add-on JSON {precipitation_behavior} is sent as same. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/precipitation_interactions.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:random_offset.doc: Add-on JSON {x?, y?, z?: {range: {min, max}, steps?}} is sent as all three axes always, {range: {min, max: float}, steps: int}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/random_offset.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:redstone_conductivity.doc: Add-on JSON {redstone_conductor, allows_wire_to_step_down} is sent as {redstoneConductor, allowsWireToStepDown: byte}. camelCase. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/redstone_conductivity.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:redstone_producer.doc: Add-on JSON {power, strongly_powered_face?, connected_faces?, transform_relative?} is sent as same + allowPowerUp: 0b, allowPowerDown: 1b; power byte. defaults: all six faces, transform_relative 1; strongly_powered_face omitted when absent. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/redstone_producer.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/redstone_producer_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:replaceable.doc: Add-on JSON {} is sent as {}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/replaceable.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:selection_box.doc: Add-on JSON false / {origin, size} is sent as {enabled: byte, origin: [float x3], size: [float x3]}. false still sends the full cube origin/size. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/selection_box_box.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/selection_box_false.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:sound.doc: Add-on JSON {sound} (a bare string is rejected) is sent as {sound: string}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/sound.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:support.doc: Add-on JSON {shape} is sent as {shape: string}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/support.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

block:minecraft:transformation.doc: Add-on JSON {rotation, scale, translation, rotation_pivot, scale_pivot} is sent as {RX, RY, RZ: int (rotation / 90), RXP.. : float (rotation pivot), SX.., SXP.. (scale, scale pivot), TX.. (translation), hasJsonVersionBeforeValidation: 0b}. per axis keys; rotation in quarter turns. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/transformation.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/blocks/transformation_rotation.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

minecraft:icon.textures.doc: texture slot (e.g. {@code default}, {@code dyed}) to texture short name

hidden_in_commands.doc: 2 = not set (default), 1 = hidden; not a boolean

hover_text_color.doc: a formatting code, e.g. {@code §c} for JSON {@code "red"}

use_duration.doc: ticks; JSON use_modifiers.use_duration is in seconds

item:item_properties.notes: Several properties mirror a component (damage, max_stack_size, foil, hand_equipped, ...).

item:minecraft:allow_off_hand.doc: Add-on JSON true / {value} is sent as {value: byte}. also item_properties.allow_off_hand. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/allow_off_hand_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/allow_off_hand_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:block_placer.doc: Add-on JSON {block, use_on, replace_block_item} is sent as {alignedPlacement: byte, block: string, canUseBlockAsIcon: byte(1), replaceBlockItem: byte, use_on: [{name, states: {}, tags: ""}]}. camelCase renames; use_on entries always expanded to {name, states, tags}; adds sibling minecraft:publisher_on_use_on: {autoSucceedOnClient: 0b}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/block_placer.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/block_placer_use_on.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:bundle_interaction.doc: Add-on JSON {num_viewable_slots} is sent as {num_viewable_slots: int}. default 12; requires storage_item. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/bundle_interaction.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/bundle_interaction_default.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:can_destroy_in_creative.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/can_destroy_in_creative_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/can_destroy_in_creative_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:compostable.doc: Add-on JSON {composting_chance: 50} is sent as {composting_chance: byte}. byte (Geyser sends int). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/compostable.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/compostable_max.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:cooldown.doc: Add-on JSON {category, duration, type?} is sent as {category: string, duration: float, type: string}. type always sent, default "use". Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/cooldown.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/cooldown_attack.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:damage.doc: Add-on JSON 5 / {value: 300} is sent as {value: short}. short (Geyser sends byte); also item_properties.damage. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/damage_absorption.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/damage_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/damage_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:damage_absorption.doc: Add-on JSON {absorbable_causes} is sent as not sent. server only. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/damage_absorption.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

destroy_speeds[].block.states.doc: state name to value; state values are ints on the wire

item:minecraft:digger.doc: Add-on JSON {use_efficiency, destroy_speeds: [{block, speed}]} is sent as {use_efficiency: byte, destroy_speeds: [{block: {name, states, tags}, speed: int}]}. block descriptor always the full triple (name "" for tag filters, tags molang string); state values become ints (pillar_axis: "y" -> 0); speed int. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/digger.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/digger_empty.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:display_name.doc: Add-on JSON {value} is sent as {value: string}. localisation keys unchanged. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/display_name.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/display_name_key.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:durability.doc: Add-on JSON {max_durability, damage_chance?} is sent as {max_durability: int, damage_chance: {min: int, max: int}}. damage_chance always sent, default 100/100 for custom items (vanilla tools send 0..100). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/durability.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/durability_chance.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/durability_sensor.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:durability_sensor.doc: Add-on JSON {durability_thresholds} is sent as not sent. server only. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/durability_sensor.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

default_color.doc: red, green, blue; JSON hex and RGB both become this list

item:minecraft:dyeable.doc: Add-on JSON {} / {default_color: "#ff0080"} / [10,20,30] is sent as {default_color: [int, int, int]}. hex and RGB both become an int list; default [255,255,255]. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/dyeable.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/dyeable_hex.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/dyeable_rgb.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:enchantable.doc: Add-on JSON {slot, value} is sent as {slot: string, value: byte}. value byte; mirrored into item_properties (int). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/enchantable.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/enchantable_all.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

entity.doc: entity identifier with a spawn event suffix, e.g. {@code minecraft:pig<>}

item:minecraft:entity_placer.doc: Add-on JSON {entity, use_on?, dispense_on?} is sent as {entity: "minecraft:pig<>", use_on: [...], dispense_on: [...]}. entity gets a <> (spawn event) suffix; descriptors as in block_placer; adds minecraft:publisher_on_use_on. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/entity_placer.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/entity_placer_full.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:fire_resistant.doc: Add-on JSON {value} only (bare true is rejected) is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/fire_resistant_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/fire_resistant_true.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:food.doc: Add-on JSON {nutrition, saturation_modifier, can_always_eat, using_converts_to} is sent as `{can_always_eat: byte, nutrition: int, saturation_modifier: float, using_converts_to: {} \. {name}}`. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/food.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/food_full.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:fuel.doc: Add-on JSON {duration} is sent as {duration: float}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/fuel.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/fuel_fraction.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:glint.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. also item_properties.foil. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/glint_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/glint_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:hand_equipped.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/hand_equipped_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/hand_equipped_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:hover_text_color.doc: Add-on JSON "red" / {value} is sent as {value: "red"}. component keeps the name; item_properties gets §c. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/hover_text_color.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/hover_text_color_full.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:icon.doc: Add-on JSON string / {textures} is sent as (item_properties only). see above. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/icon_short.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/icon_textures.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:interact_button.doc: Add-on JSON true / "text" is sent as {interact_text: string, requires_interact: 1b}. true -> "action.interact.use". Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/interact_button_text.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/interact_button_true.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

minecraft:kinetic_weapon.doc: vanilla nests the payload in a compound named like the component

item:minecraft:kinetic_weapon.notes: Vanilla 26.40 to 26.60 nest the payload in a compound named {@code minecraft:kinetic_weapon}; Geyser sends it flat.
item:minecraft:kinetic_weapon.doc: Add-on JSON {delay, reach, creative_reach, hitbox_margin, damage_multiplier, damage_modifier, *_conditions} is sent as {minecraft:kinetic_weapon: {...}}. double nested; delay short (sent, also by vanilla spears: 12s), conditions {max_duration: short (-1 default), min_speed: float, min_relative_speed: float}; creative_reach and each *_conditions omitted when absent; reach default {0, 3}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/kinetic_weapon.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/kinetic_weapon_empty.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:liquid_clipped.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/liquid_clipped_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/liquid_clipped_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

value.doc: the stack size; vanilla only shows 1, so Paletter does not read it as a boolean

item:minecraft:max_stack_size.doc: Add-on JSON 16 / {value} is sent as {value: byte}. byte. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/max_stack_size_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/max_stack_size_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:piercing_weapon.doc: Add-on JSON {reach, creative_reach?, hitbox_margin} is sent as {reach: {min, max: float}, creative_reach?, hitbox_margin: float}. creative_reach omitted when absent. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/piercing_weapon.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/piercing_weapon_empty.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

projectile_entity.doc: entity identifier with a spawn event suffix, e.g. {@code minecraft:snowball<>}

item:minecraft:projectile.doc: Add-on JSON {projectile_entity, minimum_critical_power?} is sent as {projectile_entity: "minecraft:snowball<>", minimum_critical_power: float}. namespace added, <> suffix. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/projectile.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/projectile_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:rarity.doc: Add-on JSON "rare" / {value} is sent as {value: string}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/rarity_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/rarity_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:record.doc: Add-on JSON {sound_event, duration?, comparator_signal?} is sent as {sound_event: string, duration: float, comparator_signal: int}. defaults 0.0 / 1. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/record.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/record_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:render_offsets.notes: No longer an add-on JSON component in 1.26; only Geyser still sends it. Unverified on the wire.
item:minecraft:render_offsets.doc:
Add-on JSON — is sent as —.
no longer an item component in 1.26 JSON; nothing to capture.

repair_items[].items.doc: item descriptors: either {@code name} or a Molang {@code tags} query

repair_items[].repair_amount.doc: a float for a number, a Molang string otherwise (both on the wire)

item:minecraft:repairable.doc: Add-on JSON {repair_items: [{items, repair_amount}]} is sent as `{repair_items: [{items: [{name}], repair_amount: float \. string}]}`. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/repairable.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:shooter.doc: Add-on JSON {ammunition: [{item, ...}], max_draw_duration, scale_power_by_draw_duration, charge_on_draw} is sent as same keys; ammunition[].item -> {name}; all flags as bytes, always present. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/shooter.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/shooter_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:should_despawn.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/should_despawn_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/should_despawn_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:stacked_by_data.doc: Add-on JSON bool is sent as {value: byte}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/stacked_by_data_full.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/stacked_by_data_short.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:storage_item.doc: Add-on JSON {max_slots, allow_nested_storage_items, allowed_items, banned_items} is sent as same, items as {name}, empty lists typed END. defaults 64 / 1b. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/storage_item.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/storage_item_default.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:storage_weight_limit.doc: Add-on JSON {max_weight_limit} is sent as {max_weight_limit: int}.

item:minecraft:storage_weight_modifier.doc: Add-on JSON {weight_in_storage_item} is sent as {weight_in_storage_item: int}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/storage_weight_modifier.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/storage_weight_modifier_zero.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:swing_duration.doc: Add-on JSON {value} is sent as {value: float}. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/swing_duration.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:swing_sounds.doc: Add-on JSON {attack_hit?, attack_miss?, attack_critical_hit?} is sent as same keys, strings, absent keys omitted. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/swing_sounds.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/swing_sounds_min.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:tags.notes: Vanilla also sends the same tags as the bare {@code item_tags} list; ItemComponents writes both.
item:minecraft:tags.doc: Add-on JSON {tags} is sent as {tags: [string]}. also top level item_tags. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/tags.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:throwable.doc: Add-on JSON all optional is sent as all six keys always sent (do_swing_animation byte, floats, scale_power_by_draw_duration byte). defaults launch_power_scale 1, max_launch_power 1. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/throwable.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/throwable_empty.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:use_animation.doc: Add-on JSON "eat" / {value} is sent as {value: string}. also item_properties.use_animation (int enum). Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/use_animation_eat.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/use_animation_spear.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:use_modifiers.doc: Add-on JSON {use_duration, movement_modifier?, emit_vibrations?, start_sound?} is sent as {use_duration: float, movement_modifier?: float, emit_vibrations: byte, start_sound?: string, start_using: "if_first"}. start_using added (custom default "if_first", vanilla food "always"); movement_modifier omitted when absent. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/use_modifiers.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/use_modifiers_full.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).

item:minecraft:wearable.doc: Add-on JSON {slot, protection?} is sent as {slot: string, protection: int, hides_player_location: 0b}. hides_player_location added; forces max_stack_size 1. Captured from add-on files capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/wearable_chest.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/wearable_head.json, capture/addon/behavior_pack/items/wearable_offhand.json (BDS 1.26.63.1).
